root.pivot: Approved semantic wrist, not native Empty origin
root.shared_curve: One common transform over full sequence: offsets times original D2 quintic depression; identical response for both D2 events, all finger motions jointly optimized. No per-note root or NOTE_ON relocation.
root.range_change_before_solve: Only lateral XYZ degree of freedom added: +/-2mm. Prior E2 LITTLE_DISTAL_SIDE penetrations have a shallow side-exit distance; a limited lateral motion can change side clearance while active digit offsets compensate within true D2 region. This is an engineering hypothesis, not a measured physiological bound. Existing Z/Y/pitch ranges unchanged.

hard_bounds_deg.meaning: Flexion1/2/3 then base spread. Increment from already curved RSSF rest; not global anatomical joint angles.

joints.active_curves: Each active digit gets four jointly solved offsets applied to its three inherited Bernstein pressure coefficients. Unpressed anchor unchanged; thumb additionally inherits eight bounded preparation-blend variables during shared D2 motion.
joints.idle: INDEX/MIDDLE/RING each three independently solved flexion offsets within +/-4deg of approved RSSF-derived anchors, multiplied by same D2 depression. Base spread fixed. No home-key targets; no straightening or new hook posture.

continuity.near_bound_dwell: MEASURE_ONLY; no independent .05s rejection. No contortion to meet old dwell threshold.

contact.required_contact_phase: NOTE_ON <= t < NOTE_OFF: NOTE_ON / KEY_PRESS / HOLD
contact.natural_release_phase: NOTE_OFF <= t <= NOTE_OFF+70ms and recovery: do not require pad adhesion, still screen contact geometry and continuity
contact.target_window: Approved point transported with current key, limited in-plane migration during depression; must lie in intersection with actual playable surface. Unpressed digit anchors retained.

clearance.own_patch_exemption: Only its target key margin becomes zero, actual solid penetration still penalized; no exemption for E2/F#2.

static_anchor_protection.four_source_scenes: Must remain byte-equivalent core payloads after reopen
static_anchor_protection.L1_L2_full_hand_at_dynamic_NOTE_ON: Not asserted during overlapping release; inactive/active original unpressed digit anchors and all full static scenes preserved

solver.method: One bounded deterministic scipy least_squares, single shared residual containing contact, actual evaluated skin clearance, joint/root temporal limits, idle anchor priors
solver.collocation: Original120Hz required-contact samples and natural release, plus approach/recovery quarter points. Geometry cache only for identical states within a single residual.

stop_rule: One candidate only; if contact/clearance/naturalness fail, architecture reassessment and STOP HUMAN REVIEW.
